title: Panel night with PM Logic
text: Our PMSoc team had an amazing time listening to your panel and meeting all the wonderful panelists! Thank you for sharing your insights and experiences with us! (Reposted from PMLogic’s September PM Mixer: Cracking Project Complexity.)

title: Annual General Meeting
text: On the 20th of August, members of PMSoc came together to elect the new Executive Committee for the 2026-2027 term. Congratulations to our newly elected President Chelsea Nguyen and the full incoming committee — and thank you to the outgoing 2025–2026 team for their hard work all year.

title: Industry Night S1 2026: High Risk, High Reward
text: A huge thank you to everyone who joined us on 26th May for PMSoc’s Industry Night S1 2026. Our panel of industry leaders shared invaluable insights on mastering the unexpected and navigating complex project risks, with thanks to our Gold Sponsors PM-Partners and RP Infrastructure.

title: Pitch Night: PM × AI × Innovation
text: On 15th May, PMSoc x BISA held Pitch Night — a fast-paced evening where students pitched ideas at the intersection of project management, AI and innovation, testing their pitching skills in front of a panel of judges.

title: PMSoc × KordaMentha × USYD Toastmasters Case Competition
text: On Thursday 7 May, we held the Grand Finals of the 2026 Consulting Case Competition in partnership with KordaMentha and USYD Toastmasters. Congratulations to our top 3 teams: 1st — Haki Consulting, 2nd — OKEE Advisory, and 3rd — Star Advisory.
